unknown_policy: Missing scope/date fields mean unknown, never infer ALL, a current academic year, or international status from English. retrieved_on is collection time, not academic_year/effective_date.
scope_policy: College-wide multi-department pages omit department. General campus services omit academic_level unless explicitly scoped.
tuition_policy: Academic year is admission cycle. fee_reference_year and fee_reference_term describe the quoted rate period.
